bead.title: Branch-at-position: copy-on-write queue fork on the object-log manifest
bead.description:
PROBLEM
There is no way to fork a live queue to test a workflow variant and discard it. The motivating scenario (operator, 2026-07-03): "what if I changed the delivery workflow from x to y" — pause a production delivery queue, branch it at a position, run the variant against the branch, compare, discard. TD-009 (docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-009-experimentation-pause-branch-read-as-of.md) designs the mechanics.

CURRENT STATE
- Object-log manifest and segment objects are immutable and per-(tenant,queue): ManifestEntry (crates/pqueue-objectlog/src/segmented.rs:539-549), shard_prefix (:582) — already copy-on-write-shaped.
- Leases/epochs are per-queue with a single-active-lease invariant (crates/pqueue-engine/src/control_plane.rs:14,59-89).
- Segment retention/expiry exists per TD-004 and is unaware of cross-queue references.
- read_as_of and intake-blocking pause land in dependency beads.

PROPOSED FIX
Per TD-009 section 3-4: branch(source_shard, at: CommandPosition) -> new QueueKey. Object-log: allocate a new queue identity Q-prime (new prefix + manifest series) whose manifest references the parent's immutable segment objects for sequences <= P (no data copy), diverging with its own segments after; Q-prime acquires its own control-plane lease/epoch (parent fence untouched); emit_change_records=false by default on branches; branch carries a TTL and pins the parent's segments <= P against expiry until the branch is discarded. Relational family: structured capability-unavailable until the ADR-013 rebuild-from-log migration. Document the inherited-lease behavior (reconstructed Leased items expire on the normal clock in the branch) and the shared idempotency namespace <= P.

NON-SCOPE
- Comparison/diff tooling. Automatic branch GC beyond TTL. Relational branch implementation.
bead.acceptance:
1. branch_shares_segments_and_diverges: a branch at P sees state identical to the parent at P (verified via read_as_of), post-P writes to the branch do not appear in the parent and vice versa, and no parent segment objects are duplicated in storage. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog branch_shares_segments_and_diverges
2. branch_gets_own_lease_no_parent_fence_change: the branch acquires its own assignment epoch; the parent's epoch is unchanged. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog branch_gets_own_lease_no_parent_fence_change
3. branch_suppresses_emission_by_default: no change records are emitted for branch activity unless explicitly enabled. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog branch_suppresses_emission_by_default
4. branch_pins_parent_segments_against_expiry: parent segment expiry does not delete segments referenced by a live branch; discarding the branch releases the pins. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog branch_pins_parent_segments_against_expiry
5. cargo test -p pqueue-objectlog passes.
